items.t: Oil leak from the oil pressure sensor
items.job: Replace oil pressure sensor (switch)
items.note: Estimator-based; no parts-catalog price checked. RepairPal: $176–$205 total for 2007-2012. YourMechanic: about $233 mobile, $258–$330 at a shop (its RDX average is $25 parts, $140 labor).

items.job: Transmission leak inspection
items.note: Diagnosis only: the repair depends on where it leaks (axle seal, cooler line, pan or case seal). RepairPal lists an RDX transmission leak inspection at $76–$112.

items.t: Check engine, VSA and SH-AWD lights all on
items.job: Check engine light diagnosis and testing
items.note: Diagnosis only: the VSA and SH-AWD lights usually clear once the engine fault is fixed, and that repair depends on the trouble code. RepairPal: $122–$179 for diagnosis.

items.job: Replace worn suspension control arm bushings
items.note: Estimator-based: RepairPal lists RDX control arm bushing replacement at $471–$568; the parts/labor split is approximate. A loose stabilizer link or shock mount costs less.

items.job: Diagnose stall and misfire
items.note: Diagnosis only: the fix may be a spark plug, an ignition coil or a fuel part, each priced separately. RepairPal: $122–$179 for diagnosis.

items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors
items.note: Same figures as the RDX front brake job in our maintenance data. RepairPal lists pads alone at about $300–$386.

items.t: Sudden power loss or limp mode
items.job: Engine software update and intercooler replacement (Service Bulletin 20-053)
items.note: Hours are Acura's bulletin flat rate (1.9 with camera and fog light aiming). Parts price is an aftermarket intercooler kit; the Acura kit (06198-5YF-305) price wasn't checked. RepairPal lists intercooler tube replacement at $751–$939. Ask an Acura dealer whether the bulletin repair is covered for your VIN.
